config_busy: Another operation is still in progress. Retry when it finishes.
config_conflict: Configuration changed elsewhere. Reload before saving.
config_failed: Configuration could not be loaded or saved
config_icon: Replacement icon (empty keeps the current icon)
config_name_readonly: Name and app type are read-only.
config_recovery: This older website has no recorded URL or flags. Enter its URL and confirm the flags below; Exec is not used to guess them.
config_recovery_confirm: I entered the browser flags, or explicitly chose default flags.
config_required: Check the required field and its value.
config_save_timing: Saving does not start or restart the app. Service changes apply on its next start.
config_saved: Saved. New browser settings apply on the next window.
config_saved_restart: Saved. Restart the service to apply service changes.
err_async_rejected: Noctalia did not accept the command; try again
err_cli: The app command failed. Open its logs for details.
err_failed: webapp-install failed, see the Noctalia log
err_number: URL timeout must be a positive number of seconds
err_preview_required: Enter a URL regex and a sample log line
err_regex_required: Enter a regex that extracts the complete URL
err_remove_failed: Removal failed, see the Noctalia log
err_required: A URL is required for websites and fixed URL services
err_script_required: Enter the URL extraction script command
err_setup: Could not prepare the app launcher: {detail}
field_auto_open: Open the window when the service is ready
help_extract_script: Advanced: the command reads service logs on stdin and prints one complete HTTP(S) URL on stdout. No JSON.
help_url_regex: Python regex: named group “url” > capture group 1 > whole match. The selected text must be one complete HTTP(S) URL.
installed_empty_hint: Create an app with the New app button.
logs_read_failed: Could not read the log. Try again.
logs_tail: Showing up to the last {bytes} bytes
managed_toggle: Managed app — start a local service first
metrics_scope: Resources cover the service process only.
ok_created: “{name}” created. Open it from the list.
preview_no_match: No complete HTTP(S) URL matched this log line
remove_effects_entry: Removes the desktop entry and its installed icon.
remove_effects_managed: Stops the service and removes its configuration, run records and independent browser data, including login sessions.
remove_effects_website: Removes website metadata and any app-owned profile. Shared browser data is kept.
remove_irreversible: This cannot be undone from the panel.
selected_app_missing: The selected app is no longer available.
service_window_independent: Closing a window can leave the service running.

env_file.description: Sourced while preparing and installing apps — e.g. a file exporting HTTPS_PROXY so site icons download through a proxy. Empty = none.
env_file.label: Environment file

status_preparing: Preparing the app launcher and Python environment…
tip_remove: Remove launcher, icon, service configuration and browser profile
